name: Enterprise Capacity Planning and Allocation
constraints: Capacity Plan profiles WM-ACT-008 and pins pools, demands, calendars, timezone release, unit registry and horizon.
AllocationScenario is an immutable plan-owned hypothesis release and ResourceAllocation is a scenario-owned assertion.
Scenario selection requires an authorized decision and never becomes assignment or actual use automatically.
Human assignment remains WM-ORG-016-owned, money WM-ECO-012-owned and consumption WM-FLW-015-owned.
Planned capacity, reservation, allocation, schedule, assignment and actual remain separate facts.
Variance cites immutable plan and actual revisions and never rewrites a baseline.
